Gave the shortest instead of the second.

The second shortest is the leaf, 13 cm.

questions.stem: Arjun measures a pencil with a ruler but starts from a mark that is not 0, as shown. What is the length of the pencil to the nearest cm?

explain.why: Read the right end of the line without subtracting the start mark.
Rounded to the wrong whole number of centimetres.
Counted one gap too few or too many.

solution: The line starts at 4 cm. Its right end is at about 10.1 cm.
Length = 10.1 - 4 = 6.1 cm, which is 6 cm to the nearest cm.
